title: Corporate Visa Services for UK Businesses | Manchester
description: Corporate visa services for UK businesses: business and work visas for staff, document legalisation, second passports and UK sponsorship.
h1: Corporate visa services for UK businesses
intro: If your staff travel for work, or you hire people from overseas, our corporate visa services give you one regulated partner for all of it, with a named contact, clear pricing and fast turnaround.

sections.heading: What our corporate visa services cover
sections.text:
We handle the whole range of visa and document work that businesses need:
- Business visas for staff travel, including China, India, Saudi Arabia, the USA and the Schengen area for staff on non-British passports
- Work visas for staff posted abroad, such as China, Japan, Saudi Arabia and India
- Document legalisation and attestation for company documents, commercial invoices, powers of attorney, degree certificates and police checks
- Second British passports for staff who travel frequently
- UK sponsorship: sponsor licences, Skilled Worker visas and ongoing compliance

sections.heading: How we work with businesses
sections.text:
Every corporate client gets:
- A named contact who knows your business and your travellers
- Clear, agreed pricing, with volume rates for regular work
- Urgent and same-day submission where the country allows it
- Monthly invoicing for account clients
- Simple online forms your staff can complete themselves, with their passport details filled in automatically
- Status updates until each passport or visa is back with your traveller

sections.heading: Plan ahead for busy travel
sections.text: Trade fairs, project start dates and peak travel seasons put pressure on visa centres. If you share your travel calendar with us, we'll tell you when each application needs to start, which countries need invitation letters, and which staff will need visas because of their nationality.

sections.heading: Corporate visa services from Manchester
sections.text: We're IAA-regulated and based in Manchester city centre, working with businesses across the North West and the rest of the UK. To set up a corporate account, contact us and tell us about your travel and hiring needs.

faqs.a: Yes. Regular clients can have an account with agreed pricing, a named contact and monthly invoicing.

faqs.q: Can you handle urgent business visas?
faqs.a: Yes, where the country allows it. Tell us your travel date and we’ll advise on the fastest option.

faqs.q: Do you help employers with UK sponsorship?
faqs.a: Yes. We help with sponsor licence applications, Skilled Worker visas and ongoing compliance.
